proved_parent_lemma.name: SHORT_PARENT_BAD_SECTOR_CONTAINMENT
proved_parent_lemma.statement: For max parent width <=4, every retained non-tautological exact-DP resolvent of width >4 has both pivot parents of width >=3.

r50f_questions: For each wide clause, what exact certified event removes it, shrinks it, replaces it, or allows it to survive?
For the eight normalization-cleared rank2 rescues, which existing R33 or RUP rules make the wide-clause inventory reach zero?
Can the controller replace opaque final-width acceptance with a proof-carrying WIDE_CLEARANCE_CERTIFICATE without adding a heuristic or a new semantic proof rule?
falsifiers: Any R50E rank2 rescue whose claimed cleared wide clause cannot be assigned a replayable certified disappearance/shrinkage event.
Any independently instrumented normalization final formula/hash that differs from R47J replay.
Any clearance authorization while the final formula still contains a width>4 clause.
Any new wide clause appearing without a replayable R33 BVE or RUP/R33 transformation event.
Any use of rank labels or known R50E outcomes as pre-verifier proof authority.
